newsitem.title: USA: McCormick looking at Burns Philip options.
newsitem.headline: McCormick looking at Burns Philip options.

text.p: McCormick and Co Inc is evaluating several options, spokesman Jim Lynn said Tuesday when asked about the company's interest in the spice assets Burns, Philp and Co Ltd plans to sell.
On Monday the Australian yeast maker said it would sell its U.S. and European spice and herb business.

Asked about McCormick's interest, Lynn read a statement from chief executive Robert Lawless saying: "We were aware that Burns Philip was having difficulties so their announcement does not come as a complete surprise.
"But it is far to early to tell how their actions will impact the industry or our own efforts.
"Our Executive Committee is in the process of evaluating several options."
Lynn also said Lawless would be unavailable for further comment because of an analysts meeting planned for Wednesday in New York City.
Investor relations chief Gordon Steppes said reporters were not being invited to the meeting.
It is "not a public type meeting," he explained. "This would not be an appropriate forum for the press to attend."
Asked about possible Campbell Soup Co interest, a spokesman cited the company's policy of not commenting on such subjects.
A ConAgra Inc spokeswoman said "We have a policy not to comment on being interested in assets."
H.J. Heinz Co and CPC International Inc officials did not return calls made prior to 1000 EDT/1400 GMT. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
